# Chang Energy

> Chang Energy is a commercial electricity broker for small and mid-sized businesses in Pennsylvania, Ohio, Texas, and New England. We shop vetted electricity suppliers, lock in fixed rates, manage demand charges, and audit commercial electric bills — free bill review, no obligation.

## Services

- [Free commercial bill review](https://www.changenergygroup.com/contact): line-by-line audit of your electric bill — supply rate, demand charges, contract end date.
- [What we do](https://www.changenergygroup.com/solutions): supplier procurement, capacity & demand optimization, bill audits, budget tracking.
- [Why lock in your rate](https://www.changenergygroup.com/why-chang-energy): plain-English explainer of how commercial electricity rates work, with real 2013–2024 rate data.

## Service areas

- [Pennsylvania](https://www.changenergygroup.com/locations/pennsylvania): PECO, PPL, Duquesne Light, FirstEnergy territories; PJM capacity (PLC) and transmission (NSPL) tags.
- [Texas](https://www.changenergygroup.com/locations/texas): ERCOT retail choice; Oncor, CenterPoint, AEP Texas, TNMP; 4CP summer peak transmission charges.
- [Ohio](https://www.changenergygroup.com/locations/ohio): AEP Ohio, Duke Energy Ohio, AES Ohio, FirstEnergy; PUCO choice program; PJM capacity tags.
- [New England](https://www.changenergygroup.com/locations/new-england): Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Hampshire; Eversource, National Grid, Unitil; winter price-spike protection.

## Free tools and guides

- [Blended rate calculator](https://www.changenergygroup.com/resources/blended-rate-calculator): compute your true all-in ¢/kWh from your bill.
- [Resources](https://www.changenergygroup.com/resources): block+index guides, capacity & transmission playbook, energy budget template.
- [Blog](https://www.changenergygroup.com/blog): plain-English posts on procurement, peak demand, and budget control.
